# sherpa-menu

A floating list of choices or actions. Figma "Menu" SET (1156:29240), Type axis List \| Calendar.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | overlay |
| Templates | `default`, `filter` |
| Figma | Menu |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-menu/sherpa-menu.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-menu/sherpa-menu.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-menu/sherpa-menu.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-menu/sherpa-menu.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-menu/sherpa-menu.example.json) |

## When to use it

For a floating list of choices or actions; put it in a `sherpa-button`'s `menu` slot, and the button opens it. Its rows stay native checkboxes, radios and buttons; for one pick from a known set in a form, use `sherpa-input-text` with `data-type="select"`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-button class="opener">Region</sherpa-button><sherpa-menu data-heading="Region" data-select="multiple"><label><input type="checkbox" value="emea" /> EMEA</label><label><input type="checkbox" value="apac" checked /> APAC</label></sherpa-menu>
```

`sherpa-menu` is opened with `show()`, against `.opener`.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-advanced` | boolean |  | FILTER type only: this field offers Advanced conditions, so the mode button shows. OPT-IN: most fields are answered by ticking values, and a `Contains` box over a closed set of three is noise. TRAP T-conditions-are-opt-in-per-field |
| `data-advanced-only` | boolean |  | FILTER type only: Advanced conditions and NOTHING else. Implies data-advanced, opens in advanced mode and cannot leave it, and hides the switch — there is no list behind it. For a field whose values are a wall nobody ticks: 240 emails. TRAP T-a-filter-answers-by-values-conditions-or-both |
| `data-align` | `start` `end` | `start` | start \| end which trigger edge the card lines up with |
| `data-apply-on` | `change` `input` |  |  |
| `data-available` | text |  |  |
| `data-body` | `number` `date` |  |  |
| `data-bounds` | text |  |  |
| `data-clearable` | boolean |  | show a Clear button in the footer that empties the selection (a CALENDAR menu shows Today there instead — see the footer) |
| `data-commit` | boolean |  | show the Apply / Cancel footer and DEFER changes until Apply |
| `data-commit-fixed` | boolean |  |  |
| `data-conditions` | text |  | FILTER type only: a comma-separated op list ('eq,ne,contains') in place of the default text set. |
| `data-drill` | boolean |  | the list has been replaced by a SUB-LIST — shows a back arrow and a breadcrumb in the header. Drilling IN PLACE rather than opening a second card means one box to position, nothing to close on a pointer crossing a gap, and no way for two cards to disagree about what is ticked. |
| `data-drill-from` | text |  | names the list that was replaced — the breadcrumb's text |
| `data-has-value` | text |  | written BY the menu: the typed value is not empty, so the input's Clear button shows. |
| `data-heading` | text |  | optional heading (rendered upper-case at 10/16) |
| `data-hide-unavailable` | boolean |  |  |
| `data-inline` | boolean |  | draw in the FLOW rather than the top layer — the same menu, always open, for a filter PANEL. The popover attribute is dropped, so Escape and outside-click no longer apply, and show()/hide() become no-ops. TRAP T-an-inline-menu-is-the-same-menu |
| `data-max` | text |  |  |
| `data-min` | text |  |  |
| `data-mode` | `simple` `advanced` |  | FILTER type only: simple \| advanced (Will's words). `simple` is a ticked list with a search; `advanced` is the And/Or condition rows. An Advanced button in the header moves between them. TRAP T-a-filter-menu-has-two-modes |
| `data-mode-outside` | boolean |  |  |
| `data-no-select-all` | boolean |  | a multi-select list with no Select all row — the Filters menu, where adding every filter at once is never the answer. Read when the items stamp. |
| `data-op` | text |  | FILTER type only: which condition is picked. Defaults to `eq`. The FIRST row's op — a menu in condition mode holds many. |
| `data-range` | boolean |  |  |
| `data-readonly` | boolean |  | SHOW an answer held elsewhere — rows and conditions inert, no footer, no Add condition, no Advanced button |
| `data-removable` | boolean |  | show a "Remove" button in the footer (after Today); it emits menu-select with value="remove" |
| `data-search` | boolean |  | show a search input under the heading that filters the rows |
| `data-select` | `single` `multiple` | `multiple` | multiple \| single (radio rows) |
| `data-step` | text |  |  |
| `data-takes` | `list` `text` |  | written BY the menu from data-op: list \| text. CSS reads it to reveal the rows or the text box. |
| `data-time` | boolean |  |  |
| `data-type` | `list` `calendar` `filter` | `list` | list \| calendar \| filter — the Menu set's `Type` axis. `filter` is the FILTER MENU: a condition dropdown above the search, and the text box its typing conditions use. One field gets one menu whether a chip or a column heading opens it. TRAP T-one-field-one-filter-menu TRAP T-an-operator-decides-pick-or-type `calendar` widens the card and lays the LIST region out horizontally, so a day grid and a time picker sit side by side. Everything else is the same menu. |
| `data-value` | text |  | FILTER type only: what was TYPED under a typing condition. An ATTRIBUTE because a variant re-stamp replaces the whole shadow tree, and a value living only in the box is lost. |
| `open` | boolean, native | `false` | native-ish boolean: reflects/controls the popover |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `addCondition()` | addCondition() — a new row, as the menu's own Add condition does: for a host that draws that button itself, as the panel's action row does. TODO 98 |
| `takeBaseline()` | What Cancel restores becomes what it holds NOW — for a host that wrote an answer while it is open. |
| `setCount(value: string, count: number)` | Write a child menu's pick count on its row. An empty badge draws nothing. |
| `show(trigger?: HTMLElement)` | Open the menu under `trigger`, which is also what it measures against. |
| `hide()` |  |
| `close()` |  |
| `toggle(trigger?: HTMLElement)` |  |
| `apply()` | Commit the draft and close, as the Apply button does. |
| `items(next: readonly MenuItem[])` | items([...]) — the SYNCHRONOUS door, for a caller building a detached tree. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `menu-change` | `{ values: string[] }` | The selection was COMMITTED. |
| `change` |  | The number body's field or slider changed. It stops at the shadow root. |
| `menu-apply` | `{ values: string[] }` | Apply was clicked. |
| `menu-cancel` |  | Cancel was clicked; the values are already restored. |
| `menu-clear` |  | Clear was clicked; the selection is already empty. |
| `menu-select` | `{ label: string; value: 'remove' \| string }` | An action row was clicked. |
| `menu-drill` | `{ value: string }` | A row's child-menu caret. |
| `menu-open` |  |  |
| `menu-close` |  |  |
| `condition-change` | `{ conditions: FieldCondition[]; op: FilterOp; value: string }` | The condition or its typed value changed. |
| `condition-mode-change` | `{ mode: ConditionType }` | The mode button was pressed. |
| `menu-row-remove` | `{ value: string }` | A row's × was pressed. |
| `menu-range-change` | `{ range: boolean }` | A number or date body's Range switch flipped. |
| `menu-items` | `{ values: string[] }` | Its items were stamped, so a host can read its face. |
| `menu-back` |  | A drilled menu's back arrow or crumb. |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `header` | control | controls ABOVE the heading (a calendar's month stepper). |
| (default) | item | the rows (labels with inputs, or buttons). |
| `footer` | control | the host's own footer buttons, leading the footer row; the row shows once it is filled (a Find's Replace, Previous and Next) |
